scope: Actual model-selection storage, latch/transition and resume/header predicates. Bare-wire family branch has supplied absent served aliases, overrides and transport parsing. Initial launch model, provider/feature gates, transcript frames and origin ids are explicit facts; full host acquisition, server-swapped response/effort handling and complete JSONL envelopes remain separate.

resumeFacts.coldModelLoader: lCe calls N(history, configuredModel); N scans backward for a non-meta assistant message.message.model. It does not select from a refusal notice.
resumeFacts.latestNoticeSelector: ie selects the latest system row with subtype model_refusal_fallback and does not inspect scope.
resumeFacts.resumeLatchCondition: cCe compares that notice.fallbackModel to the model already selected by lCe; originalModel does not participate.
resumeFacts.coldLatchSlots: previousOverride is undefined; previousAppStateModel is KL() ?? null; previousModelForSession is explicitly null.
resumeFacts.hotClear: vvt keeps the first live latch restoration slots across a B-to-C hop; vn clears only while the current override is still the latched fallback and returns those saved slots.
resumeFacts.providerProfiles: The native model-selection latch has no provider-profile slot; profile restoration in Harness is a host extension.
